name: MainPlace Mall
description: MainPlace Mall is Orange County's premier enclosed regional shopping destination, featuring over 140 stores and restaurants anchored by major department stores including Macy's, JCPenney, and Nordstrom Rack. Located in the heart of Santa Ana, this 1.1 million square-foot mall offers a diverse shopping experience with a mix of national retailers, dining options, and family-friendly entertainment.
demographics: Serving the diverse Santa Ana community and broader Orange County area with a strong Hispanic demographic presence and middle-income families.
summary: Orange County's premier enclosed regional mall with 140+ stores, major department store anchors, and diverse shopping and dining options in Santa Ana.
